_doc: OPTIMIZER POOL + DEPLOY ORDER — single source of truth for per-(contract,chain) optimizer settings, codehashes, AND the launch sequence. Run deploy/sync_optimizer_pool.sh to fill init_codehash / deployed_codehash / runtime_bytes. RULE: a codehash-pattern factory (PossessioFactory) pins a template's init_codehash IMMUTABLY at deploy — so a template's optimizer is FROZEN once its factory is live. Deploy STRICTLY in `step` order; each proven live before the next (Codebyte: one at a time).
_deploy_order: Pools first (rails -> reservoir), then contracts, then the Ethereum anchor last (separate chain, gated on the Base Builder grant / Fundstrat). Steps flagged CONFIRM need the Architect's ruling before they are locked.

hot.for: small + called constantly — cheap runtime forever

l1.for: Ethereum L1 — balance expensive deploy vs expensive runtime

contracts.name: PossessioSaltPool
contracts.reason: deployed once, rarely called — deploy size over runtime. FIRST: it provides the deterministic-address rail the rest deploy onto.

contracts.name: STEEL
contracts.reason: must exist before the hook that references it as STEEL_TOKEN. Shares the v2.6.3 compilation with the hook (one file), so it inherits runs=1.

contracts.name: PossessioHook
contracts.reason: the reservoir. Needs STEEL (step 2) + a MINED hook address (V4 permission bits). Pool init (PoolManager.initialize) follows immediately. runs=1 is REQUIRED to fit under 24KB — not a cost choice.

contracts.name: PossessioPool
contracts.role: pool template — CONFIRM: is this PossessioFactory's template, or a standalone pool? Its position vs the factory depends on the answer.
contracts.reason: IF it is the factory template, its init_codehash is pinned into PossessioFactory at step 5 — so it must be compiled/finalized before the factory. CONFIRM role + order.

contracts.name: PossessioFactory
contracts.reason: pins the template's init_codehash IMMUTABLY at construction — so the template (step 4) must be finalized first. Its own optimizer is independent of the templates it deploys.

contracts.name: PossessioPayments
contracts.reason: hit on every payment — optimize runtime (runs=10000); small enough to fit hot.

contracts.name: PossessioX402Core
contracts.reason: called per-trade — cheaper execution compounds over volume.

contracts.name: PossessioWhiskyMarket
contracts.reason: auction/settlement, moderate call frequency — start at default; revisit to hot once live if bid gas matters. CONFIRM: this launch, or a later phase?

contracts.name: L1AnchorFactory
contracts.reason: SEPARATE CHAIN, LAST — gated on the Base Builder grant / Fundstrat email. Deploying it deploys L1Anchor with it (embedded). Expensive L1 favors a moderate balance (runs=800).

contracts.name: L1Anchor
contracts.reason: WELDED to L1AnchorFactory (embedded new) — not independently deployed; shares the factory's setting. Listed for the codehash record only.
